name: codex-orchestration
description: Nested Terra orchestration with root-only experience verification.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.8.17 adds a direct root fast path for ordinary read-only follow-ups, so explanations, summaries, status questions, and rationale already present in the conversation return without Terra classification, tools, or subagents. Mutation, fresh verification, audits, and substantial research still route through the fused GPT-5.6 Terra / Max orchestrator. Continuity now carries a bounded recent-conversation window and marks an older completion capsule stale when newer root conversation exists, preventing later agreements from being overwritten by earlier milestone state. Ambiguous commands such as do the next step must resolve to an exact recent decision and can never be inferred from repository architecture documents. Acceptance contracts name concrete outcomes, destinations, and open commitments; build supervisors independently compare them with the user request and recent context before an implementer starts. Read-only fallback work stays silent until its single final answer, supervisor checkpoints render as readable Markdown, and Remaining can be None only after every explicit commitment has decisive proof. Six specialized companion profiles preserve the fixed tweak and build routes with pinned fallbacks, serial checkpoint handoffs, root-only experience verification, and conflict-safe installation.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat tweak/build routing with checkpoint supervision.
